data.split_dataset module

Dataset Split Script for Object Detection Splits images and COCO annotations into train/val/test sets Ensures no overlap between splits

data.split_dataset.copy_images(source_root: Path, dest_root: Path, image_filenames: List[str], verbose: bool = True)[source]

Copy images from source to destination. Handles nested folder structure.

Parameters:

  • source_root – Root directory containing source images

  • dest_root – Destination directory

  • image_filenames – List of image filenames (may include subfolders)

  • verbose – Print progress

data.split_dataset.create_split_annotations(coco_data: Dict, split_image_ids: List[int]) → Dict[source]

Create COCO annotations for a specific split.

Parameters:

  • coco_data – Full COCO annotation dictionary

  • split_image_ids – Image IDs for this split

Returns:

New COCO annotation dictionary for the split

data.split_dataset.load_coco_annotations(ann_file: Path) → Dict[source]

Load COCO format annotations.

data.split_dataset.main()[source]
data.split_dataset.split_images_by_id(image_ids: List[int], train_ratio: float = 0.7, val_ratio: float = 0.15, test_ratio: float = 0.15, seed: int = 42) → Tuple[List[int], List[int], List[int]][source]

Split image IDs into train/val/test sets.

Parameters:

  • image_ids – List of all image IDs

  • train_ratio – Proportion for training (default 0.7 = 70%)

  • val_ratio – Proportion for validation (default 0.15 = 15%)

  • test_ratio – Proportion for test (default 0.15 = 15%)

  • seed – Random seed for reproducibility

Returns:

Tuple of (train_ids, val_ids, test_ids)
